hot-isnt-a-personality.angle: 1. The "He's Hot. But Is He Interesting?" Angle
hot-isnt-a-personality.primaryText:
Your morally gray love interest has a dagger, a tragic past, and excellent cheekbones.
But does he have a personality? 😬
This free interactive deck can help with that.
headlines: Give Him More Than a Jawline
hot-isnt-a-personality.description: 30 prompts for a love interest readers can't quite figure out.

character-click.primaryText:
He looks right. He sounds right.
He has all the morally gray ingredients.
So why does he still feel...flat?
character-click.description: Use 30 targeted prompts to find the missing layer.

but-listen.primaryText:
The best morally gray characters don't make readers say, "He's hot."
They make readers say, "Okay, BUT LISTEN—"
Let's build that guy.
but-listen.description: 30 prompts for deliciously complicated love interests.

ask-better-questions.primaryText:
You don't need to know his favorite breakfast cereal.
You need to know what loving her will cost him.
These are those character questions.
ask-better-questions.description: 30 story-changing prompts for morally gray love interests.

draw-at-your-own-risk.primaryText:
Go ahead. Draw one.
But don't blame me when one innocent little question changes his entire backstory.
You were warned.
draw-at-your-own-risk.description: 30 prompts. Six angles. One dangerously interesting love interest.
